rows.note: This is the direct choice for hitting a person or animal with a whip.

example.english: The groom used a whip to whip the horse and make it go faster.
example.traditional: 嗰個馬夫用鞭鞭隻馬，叫佢快啲行。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 maa5 fu1 jung6 bin1 bin1 zek3 maa5 giu3 keoi5 faai3 di1 haang4

rows.note: Use this specifically for rapidly beating or aerating eggs, cream, or similar food.

example.english: I whip the egg whites until they are stiff.
example.jyutping: ngo5 daa2 faat3 daan2 baak6 daa2 dou3 kei5 san1

rows.note: Use this colloquial Hong Kong expression when one side defeats another decisively in a game or contest.

example.english: They managed to whip us badly in the match.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 bei2 deoi3 sau2 daai6 caau2 zo2
